title: Transcendental correspondences: when Fuchsian groups take over basins of entire maps
summary: In this paper, we initiate a systematic study of $(\infty : \infty)$ holomorphic correspondences that naturally arise as conformal combinations (matings) of transcendental entire maps with Fuchsian groups. This construction parallels the recent theory of finite-degree algebraic correspondences associated with rational maps. Our correspondence combines the dynamics of a transcendental entire function outside a distinguished attracting/parabolic basin with the action of a compatible Fuchsian group within it.
